reviews.title: Great card
reviews.comment: I was upgrading from a 3060 to this card. Installation was a breeze and I had no issues with reinstalling everything. Great picture and better quality. It's not noisy and it's performing as expected.
reviews.author: Terri Lynn Cox

reviews.title: Good card if you get it on sale, but opt for the 16GB if you’re paying full price.
reviews.comment: Got it on a sale and I’ll put it like this. I upgraded from a 1660 super and to me it looks phenomenal, but if you have anything more recent than a 3050 I’d recommend going for the 16gb variant. Otherwise, card looks great and runs my games (modded Skyrim VR, Cyberpunk, Counter Strike) at high settings in 1080p. Not very loud either,
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: Loving this new gpu
reviews.comment: Easy install, on top of a great upgrade from my previous gpu.
reviews.author: kadedrick

reviews.title: 5060ti 8gb
reviews.comment: Yes people are saying the 8gb vram isn’t the greatest but this a good budget card for people with older systems without upgrading everything I have ran every game so far 144 high settings 1440p as well if u dont mind the vram problem isn’t really a problem right now maybe in the future but for right now its a great card
reviews.author: Wyatt kotwitz

reviews.title: Love!
reviews.comment: Love love love my Gefirce RTX! It’s functionally awesome fast, super compatible with my system looks amazing! Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for parts for a new build!
